bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: Futures volume represents the purest form of volume and order flow because it records centralized buying and selling by major market operators, directly revealing market sentiment, momentum, and when a price move is running out of steam.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Volume in the futures market, which is the purest form of buying and selling reveals when the market is running out of steam. It reveals whether buying interest is rising or falling on a daily basis.

facts.statement: Cash stock markets (NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE SETS) are heavily manipulated by licensed insiders, specialists, and market makers who control order flow, manage inventory, and can delay or hide large volume blocks in after-hours trading.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Stock markets are heavily manipulated by licensed insiders, specialists and market makers... These operators control order flow, manage inventory, and can delay or hide large volume blocks (such as reporting transactions in after-hours trading).

facts.statement: Before the cash open, futures markets trade overnight on Globex to establish sentiment; market makers then test price levels during the opening few minutes by marking prices up or down on low volume to check sentiment before committing inventory.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Remember from earlier in the book, that the futures index markets will have already been trading overnight on Globex... All that is needed is to test out the price level at which to pitch the price for the opening few minutes.

facts.statement: Spot Forex is a decentralized over-the-counter market without a single exchange, meaning true total volume, exact transaction sizes, or total currency amounts exchanged are not centrally reported.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: In the spot forex market we have a different problem. There is no true volume reported. Even if there were, would this be shown as trade size, or 'amounts of currency' being exchanged.

facts.statement: Tick volume measures the frequency of price changes (ticks) within a given timeframe, serving as an effective proxy for actual market order flow because high activity and rapid price changes directly mirror heavy trading volume.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Tick volume measures the frequency of price changes (ticks) within a given period. Various industry studies show that tick volume data acts as a proxy that is 90% representative of actual market activity.

facts.topic: The 90% Proxy Rule for Tick Volume
facts.statement: Empirical studies confirm that tick volume data serves as a proxy that is approximately 90% representative of true market order flow activity, providing forex traders with a substantial analytical edge over price action alone.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The short answer is yes, and various studies over the years have shown that tick data as a proxy for 'volume' is 90% representative in terms of the true 'activity' in the market.

facts.statement: During the monthly U.S. Non-Farm Payrolls release on a 233-tick chart, bar formation accelerates from minutes to seconds—appearing like a machine gun filling a full frame in minutes—visually proving how activity equates to volume.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Take the monthly Non Farm Payroll... Prior to the release each 233 tick bar may be taking a few minutes to form. During the release and immediately after, each bar is forming in seconds, appearing as if being fired onto the screen using a machine gun!

facts.statement: Tick volume data is not uniform across platforms; feed quality varies depending on whether an online broker subscribes directly to interbank liquidity pools using wholesale feeds, though standard retail feeds remain fully effective.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: First, the tick volumes on one platform will vary from the tick volumes on another, since tick data will be provided through the platform of an online broker... depending on whether the broker is subscribed directly to the interbank liquidity pool.

facts.statement: Market activity and volume equal the frequency of price changes, expressed as frequency of price changes (ticks) equals market activity equals volume.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Frequency of Price Changes (Ticks) = Market Activity = Volume.

facts.statement: Volume without associated price action merely indicates activity without direction; combining price action and volume creates the essential chemical reaction required for Volume Price Analysis.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: An auction room with no price bidding represents pure volume bars without direction; price and volume must be combined to form Volume Price Analysis.

facts.statement: VPA is a subjective art rather than a rigid science. Traders must never evaluate volume as an absolute number, but rather judge current bar height relative to preceding volume bars on the exact same data feed.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: All volume is relative. Suppose for example this had been our first visit to this particular auction room. Is the activity witnessed average, above average or below average. We would not be able to say, since we have no yardstick by which to judge.

facts.statement: Data feed accuracy is secondary to feed consistency; whether a proxy feed is 90%, 80%, or 70% accurate is irrelevant as long as the data feed remains consistent, because traders compare imperfect data against imperfect data on the same chart.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Data feed accuracy is secondary to feed consistency... whether a data feed or tick proxy is 90%, 80%, or 70% accurate is irrelevant, provided the feed remains consistent, because you are comparing imperfect data against imperfect data on the same chart.

facts.topic: Sufficiency of Free Retail Tick Feeds
facts.statement: Free tick data feeds provided on standard retail trading platforms such as MetaTrader 4 are completely sufficient for daily profitable trading when evaluated using relative volume principles.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Practical Application: Free tick data feeds provided on standard platforms (such as MetaTrader 4) are completely sufficient for daily profitable trading when evaluated relatively.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
